system.description:
DIVINITY KETHRANI

Entire prayers now emerge upon your flesh overnight, complete in languages you sometimes do not recognize.
During your daily preparations, select one, non-Specialist Divinity spell with a base PP cost of 4 or less.
Until your next daily preparations, you may cast that spell as a Divinity innate spell with the Focus trait.

Prerequisites Level 15

Use at daily preparation: choose any non-specialist Divinity spell of base PP 4 or less — it lands as an innate Focus spell until your next choice.
